newsitem.title: USA: Maytag signs commercial washer supplier.
newsitem.headline: Maytag signs commercial washer supplier.

text.p: Maytag Corp said Tuesday it signed a new North American supply and distribution agreement for multi-load commercial washers to bolster its commercial laundry business.

Under the agreement, Primus, a Belgian company, will supply Maytag with its line of European-made, oversized front-loading commercial washers. The washers will be sold in the United States and Canada under the Maytag brand name.

"We now can offer our customers a complete line of premium quality, multi-load commercial washers," Ronald Fey, commercial laundry division manager for Maytag Appliances, said in a statement. "This should strengthen and improve our business in the coin operated laundry market and will open up a whole new market for Maytag in on-premise laundry."

The Primus washers are designed for use in hospitals, hotels, nursing homes, athletic clubs, and other facilities where large volumes of laundry are done on premise, as well as in coin laundry stores, Maytag said.

"This is another example of targeting specific markets where we believe we can grow profitably," Leonard Hadley, Maytag chairman, said in a statement. "Maytag is a market leader in providing coin operated laundry equipment throughout the U.S. and Canada."
He added that introduction of a Maytag brand horizontal-axis high-efficiency washer this year also promises growth for the commercial business.
Maytag makes home appliances for laundry, cooking, dishwashing, refrigeration, and floor care.
